primitives.name: Status Forward Propagation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Spot status-only updates may repeat the price timestamp with `isCarriedForward: true`; do not deduplicate by timestamp alone.
primitives.assumptions: Status updates are idempotent; repeated identical updates preserve information.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Deduplication by timestamp alone violates causality; forward flags prevent loss.

layer2.mapping: Captures temporal consistency in status streams using forward indicators.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of forward-propagated updates vs. unique status changes.

primitives.name: Snapshot Status Reversion
primitives.verbatim_quote: Older unstated spot frames retain the last stated snapshot status.
primitives.assumptions: Historical status is retroactively consistent; no information erasure occurs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unstated frames revert to the most recent known value; no divergence.

layer2.mapping: Imputes missing status via backward filling, preserving temporal coherence.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of reversion vs. direct observations.

primitives.name: TWAP Status Change
primitives.verbatim_quote: Snapshots carry status at batch level and may retain an older closing price; TWAP status changes with a new price.

primitives.assumptions: TWAP prices drive status transitions; batch-level status is conservative.
primitives.breakdown_regime: New prices trigger immediate status shifts; older prices are stale.

layer2.mapping: Links TWAP dynamics to status updates, creating a feedback loop between price and availability.
